panels.title: Node identity and state — NOT VALIDATED — nominal calibration (no reference meter)
panels.description: Permanent calibration label: NOT VALIDATED — nominal calibration (no reference meter). The table shows latest node status and last valid update metadata.

targets.query:
// Panel 1 — node identity, current status, calibration, clock, and last valid update.
import "array"

statusData = from(bucket: "operations")
    |> range(start: -30d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node_status" and r.node_id == "${node}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["acquisition_state", "clock_source", "firmware_version", "calibration_revision", "last_measurement_age_s"]))
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> last()
    |> yield(name: "latest_node_metadata")

stateData = from(bucket: "operations")
    |> range(start: -30d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node_status" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r._field == "state")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "node_id", "_field", "_value"])

union(tables: [stateData, array.from(rows: [{_time: time(v: 0), node_id: "${node}", _field: "state", _value: "NO DATA"}])])
    |> group(columns: ["node_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> last()
    |> yield(name: "latest_node_status")

validUpdate = from(bucket: "energy_raw")
    |> range(start: -30d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical_measurement" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r.quality == "valid" and r._field == "active_power_W")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, node_id: r.node_id, circuit_id: r.circuit_id, calibration_revision: r.calibration_revision, _field: "last_valid_update", _value: string(v: r._time), last_valid_age_s: string(v: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0)}))

union(tables: [validUpdate, array.from(rows: [{_time: time(v: 0), node_id: "${node}", circuit_id: "unknown", calibration_revision: "unknown", _field: "last_valid_update", _value: "NO DATA", last_valid_age_s: "NO DATA"}])])
    |> group(columns: ["node_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: if r._value == "NO DATA" then now() else r._time}))
    |> yield(name: "last_valid_update")

panels.title: Current cards — values require online state and a valid window no older than 15 s
panels.description: Each row includes value or status text, unit, timestamp, and quality. A stale, offline, missing, degraded, or invalid reading is never shown as a number. Import energy includes Wh and Wh/1000 as kWh.

targets.query:
// Panel 2 — current cards. Values are strings so status text can replace a number safely.
import "join"
import "array"

statusData = from(bucket: "operations")
    |> range(start: -15m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node_status" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r._field == "state")
    |> rename(columns: {_value: "node_state"})
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "node_id", "node_state"])

latestStatus = union(tables: [statusData, array.from(rows: [{_time: time(v: 0), node_id: "${node}", node_state: "NO DATA"}])])
    |> group(columns: ["node_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> last(column: "node_state")

windowData = from(bucket: "energy_raw")
    |> range(start: -15m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical_measurement" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r._field == "quality_flags")
    |> rename(columns: {_value: "window_flags", _time: "window_time"})
    |> keep(columns: ["node_id", "quality", "calibration_revision", "window_flags", "window_time"])

latestWindow = union(tables: [windowData, array.from(rows: [{node_id: "${node}", quality: "unknown", calibration_revision: "unknown", window_flags: "", window_time: time(v: 0)}])])
    |> group(columns: ["node_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["window_time"])
    |> last(column: "window_flags")

statusWithWindow = join.left(
    left: latestStatus,
    right: latestWindow,
    on: (l, r) => l.node_id == r.node_id,
    as: (l, r) => ({l with latest_quality: r.quality, calibration_revision: r.calibration_revision, window_flags: r.window_flags, window_time: r.window_time}),
)

card = (field, label, unit, energy) => {
    readingData = from(bucket: "energy_raw")
        |> range(start: -30d)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical_measurement" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r.quality == "valid" and r._field == field)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, node_id: r.node_id, circuit_id: r.circuit_id, calibration_revision: r.calibration_revision, _value: float(v: r._value), has_reading: true}))

    reading = union(tables: [readingData, array.from(rows: [{_time: time(v: 0), node_id: "${node}", circuit_id: "unknown", calibration_revision: "unknown", _value: 0.0, has_reading: false}])])
        |> group(columns: ["node_id"])
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
        |> last()
        |> rename(columns: {_value: "reading", _time: "reading_time", calibration_revision: "reading_calibration_revision"})

    return join.left(
        left: statusWithWindow,
        right: reading,
        on: (l, r) => l.node_id == r.node_id,
        as: (l, r) => ({l with circuit_id: r.circuit_id, reading_calibration_revision: r.reading_calibration_revision, reading: r.reading, reading_time: r.reading_time, has_reading: r.has_reading}),
    )
        |> map(fn: (r) => {
            age_s = if r.has_reading then float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r.reading_time)) / 1000000000.0 else 999999.0
            hasBadWindow = exists r.latest_quality and (r.latest_quality == "degraded" or r.latest_quality == "invalid")
            reason = if exists r.window_flags and r.window_flags != "" then r.window_flags else if exists r.latest_quality then r.latest_quality else "quality unavailable"
            live = r.node_state == "online" and r.has_reading and age_s <= 15.0 and exists r.latest_quality and r.latest_quality == "valid"
            display = if r.node_state == "NO DATA" then "NO DATA" else if r.node_state == "offline" then "OFFLINE" else if hasBadWindow then reason else if r.node_state == "stale" or (r.has_reading and age_s > 15.0) or r.node_state == "degraded" then "STALE" else if live then (if energy then string(v: r.reading) + " Wh / " + string(v: r.reading / 1000.0) + " kWh" else string(v: r.reading)) else "NO DATA"
            quality = if r.node_state == "NO DATA" then "no data" else if r.node_state == "offline" then "offline" else if hasBadWindow then reason else if live then "valid" else if r.node_state == "stale" or (r.has_reading and age_s > 15.0) or r.node_state == "degraded" then "stale" else "no data"
            return {_time: if r.has_reading then r.reading_time else now(), node_id: r.node_id, circuit_id: r.circuit_id, metric: label, value: display, unit: unit, reading_time: if r.has_reading then string(v: r.reading_time) else "—", quality: quality, calibration_revision: r.reading_calibration_revision}
        })
}

union(tables: [
    card(field: "voltage_rms_V", label: "V RMS", unit: "V", energy: false),
    card(field: "current_rms_A", label: "I RMS", unit: "A", energy: false),
    card(field: "active_power_W", label: "Active power", unit: "W", energy: false),
    card(field: "active_energy_import_total_Wh", label: "Import energy", unit: "Wh / kWh", energy: true),
])
    |> yield(name: "current_cards")

panels.title: Active power — valid windows only
panels.description: Missing windows remain gaps; an explicit null is inserted after gaps longer than 10 s. Nominal values are not validated.

targets.query:
// Panel 3 — valid active-power windows; insert a null point after gaps longer than 10 s.
import "internal/debug"

power = from(bucket: "energy_raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical_measurement" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r.quality == "valid" and r._field == "active_power_W")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> elapsed(unit: 1s, columnName: "elapsed_s")

powerValues = power
    |> drop(columns: ["elapsed_s"])

gapBreaks = power
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.elapsed_s > 10)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: time(v: int(v: r._time) - 5000000000), _value: debug.null(type: "float")}))
    |> drop(columns: ["elapsed_s"])

union(tables: [powerValues, gapBreaks])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> yield(name: "valid_active_power_W")

panels.title: Voltage and current — nominal calibrated ranges
panels.description: Green threshold bands mark the expected ranges: 10–16 V and 0.5–2.0 A. This is a plausibility range, not a validated operating or accuracy claim.

targets.query:
// Panel 4 — valid RMS voltage/current; calibrated ranges are shaded by Grafana field thresholds.
from(bucket: "energy_raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical_measurement" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r.quality == "valid")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["voltage_rms_V", "current_rms_A"]))
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> yield(name: "valid_voltage_current")

panels.title: Energy by hour, day, and week — counter differences, NOT VALIDATED
panels.description: Each step is a valid cumulative-counter difference. The plotted hour is Lima local time.

targets.query:
import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Lima")

from(bucket: "energy_raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical_measurement" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r.quality == "valid")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "active_energy_import_total_Wh" or r._field == "counter_id")
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "counter_id", "active_energy_import_total_Wh"])
    |> group(columns: ["counter_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> difference(columns: ["active_energy_import_total_Wh"])
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.active_energy_import_total_Wh and r.active_energy_import_total_Wh >= 0.0)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: time(v: int(v: r._time) - 1000000), _value: float(v: r.active_energy_import_total_Wh)}))
    |> group()
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
    |> group()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with result: "hourly_energy_Wh"}))
    |> yield(name: "hourly_energy_Wh")

panels.title: Peak hour — Lima time and Wh — NOT VALIDATED
panels.description: The local start time and Wh from the single highest hourly counter difference.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"

option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Lima")

hourly = from(bucket: "energy_raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical_measurement" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r.quality == "valid")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "active_energy_import_total_Wh" or r._field == "counter_id")
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "counter_id", "active_energy_import_total_Wh"])
    |> group(columns: ["counter_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> difference(columns: ["active_energy_import_total_Wh"])
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.active_energy_import_total_Wh and r.active_energy_import_total_Wh >= 0.0)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: time(v: int(v: r._time) - 1000000), _value: float(v: r.active_energy_import_total_Wh)}))
    |> group()
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

hourly
    // earliest hour wins a tie: sort on (value, -time), both descending
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with neg_time: -int(v: r._time)}))
    |> sort(columns: ["_value", "neg_time"], desc: true)
    |> limit(n: 1)
    |> drop(columns: ["neg_time"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with result: "peak_hour"}))
    |> map(fn: (r) => {
        year = string(v: date.year(t: r._time))
        month = date.month(t: r._time)
        day = date.monthDay(t: r._time)
        hour = date.hour(t: r._time)
        minute = date.minute(t: r._time)
        monthText = if month < 10 then "0" + string(v: month) else string(v: month)
        dayText = if day < 10 then "0" + string(v: day) else string(v: day)
        hourText = if hour < 10 then "0" + string(v: hour) else string(v: hour)
        minuteText = if minute < 10 then "0" + string(v: minute) else string(v: minute)
        localStart = year + "-" + monthText + "-" + dayText + " " + hourText + ":" + minuteText
        return {r with peak_hour_lima: localStart}
    })
    |> yield(name: "peak_hour")

panels.title: Alert history — evidence, state, and webhook delivery
panels.description: Transitions and latest notification state. Measurement-derived values remain NOT VALIDATED.

targets.query:
// Panel 7 — alert evidence, state transitions, and latest webhook delivery state.
import "join"
import "internal/debug"

transitions = from(bucket: "operations")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert_transition" and r.node_id == "${node}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["alert_id", "from_status", "actor", "reason", "observed_value", "threshold_value", "notification_state"]))
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    // health and quality alerts carry no values: give every row the same columns
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
        observed_value: if exists r.observed_value then r.observed_value else debug.null(type: "float"),
        threshold_value: if exists r.threshold_value then r.threshold_value else debug.null(type: "float"),
    }))
    |> rename(columns: {to_status: "status"})
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "node_id", "kind", "severity", "status", "alert_id", "from_status", "actor", "reason", "observed_value", "threshold_value", "notification_state"])
    |> group(columns: ["alert_id"])

notifications = from(bucket: "operations")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert_notification" and r.node_id == "${node}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["alert_id", "attempt_count", "last_error_code"]))
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    // `last_error_code` is written only on failures: add it where it is missing
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with last_error_code: if exists r.last_error_code then r.last_error_code else ""}))
    |> rename(columns: {state: "latest_notification_state", attempt_count: "latest_attempt_count", last_error_code: "latest_error_code"})
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "alert_id", "latest_notification_state", "latest_attempt_count", "latest_error_code"])
    |> group(columns: ["alert_id"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> tail(n: 1)  // latest delivery state per alert (`last()` needs a _value column)

join.left(
    left: transitions,
    right: notifications,
    on: (l, r) => l.alert_id == r.alert_id,
    as: (l, r) => ({l with notification_state: if exists r.latest_notification_state then r.latest_notification_state else l.notification_state, latest_attempt_count: r.latest_attempt_count, latest_error_code: r.latest_error_code}),
)
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
    |> yield(name: "alert_history")

// Panel 6b — recent quality flags; empty flag strings are omitted.
from(bucket: "energy_raw")
    |> range(start: -24h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical_measurement" and r.node_id == "${node}" and (r.quality == "degraded" or r.quality == "invalid") and r._field == "quality_flags")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != "")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "node_id", "circuit_id", "quality", "_value"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
    |> limit(n: 100)
    |> yield(name: "recent_quality_flags")

// Panel 8a — pipeline counters converted to per-second rates plus ingest latency.
from(bucket: "operations")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline" and r.component == "ingestion")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["received_total", "accepted_total", "rejected_total", "duplicate_total", "conflict_total"]))
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
    |> yield(name: "pipeline_counter_rates")

// Panel 8b — most recent node queue state.
from(bucket: "operations")
    |> range(start: -15m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node_status" and r.node_id == "${node}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["pending_records", "oldest_pending_age_s", "state"]))
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> last()
    |> yield(name: "node_queue_status")

// Panel 8c — latest rejected/conflict events.
from(bucket: "operations")
    |> range(start: -24h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ingest_event" and r.node_id == "${node}")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "node_id", "result", "_field", "_value"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
    |> limit(n: 100)
    |> yield(name: "recent_ingest_events")

// Panel 8d — age of the newest energy_raw point, in seconds.
from(bucket: "energy_raw")
    |> range(start: -30d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "electrical_measurement" and r.node_id == "${node}" and r._field == "active_power_W")
    |> group(columns: ["node_id"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0, _field: "last_point_age_s"}))
    |> yield(name: "energy_raw_last_point_age")
